Natalie Ko is an Engineering Major at [Harvey Mudd College](https://hmc.edu) with a Science, Technology, and Society concentration. She's interested in mechatronics and robotics. On campus, she works as a Repair Steward for Harvey Mudd's Makerspace, CAD Lab TA/Grutor/Designer for the E4 course, and Shop Proctor for the Machine Shop.

When Natalie isn't working on coursework or on-campus jobs, she works on other cool Engineering personal projects, including iterating on functional Spiderman web-shooters since 2018. She's primarily drawn to projects that help foster a more accessible world.
